prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1480; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the individual injured in the collision described below, which occurred while the insured vehicle was changing lanes and made contact with my client's vehicle. My client has sustained injuries that are being evaluated and treated, and this letter confirms that all further communication regarding this matter, including contact with my client, should be directed exclusively to this office. Please do not contact my client directly or request statements from them.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any other coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dashcam or telematics data, recorded statements, claim file notes, repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic data from the insured vehicle. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.
